name: Queen of Sheba
title: The Wise Queen from the South
summary: The Queen of Sheba was a powerful ruler who traveled to Jerusalem to test King Solomon's wisdom with difficult questions. She was deeply impressed by his wisdom, wealth, and organization, and praised the God of Israel for giving Israel such a king.

keyEvents.title: Hearing About Solomon's Fame
keyEvents.description: The Queen of Sheba heard about Solomon's reputation and his relationship with the Lord, and decided to test him with riddles.

keyEvents.title: The Journey to Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: She came to Jerusalem with a very large entourage, with camels loaded with spices, great amounts of gold, and precious stones.

keyEvents.title: Conversations with Solomon
keyEvents.description: She presented to Solomon everything on her heart, and he answered all her questions - nothing was too difficult for the king to explain.

keyEvents.title: Overwhelmed by Solomon's Wisdom
keyEvents.description: When the queen saw all Solomon's wisdom, the house he had built, the food on his table, and his servants, she was left speechless with amazement.

keyEvents.title: Praising the God of Israel
keyEvents.description: She blessed the Lord, the God of Israel, who had taken pleasure in Solomon and placed him on the throne of Israel to administer justice and righteousness.

keyEvents.title: Exchange of Gifts and Departure
keyEvents.description: She gave the king 120 talents of gold, a very large amount of spices, and precious stones. Solomon gave her everything she asked for, and she returned to her own land.
